t: The $(thing)Text/$ widget is only used as a parameter for other widgets. It is used to provide textual data for those widgets that need it.$(p)The following pages list those widgets that use it.
$(thing)文本/$组件仅作为其他组件的参数使用，用于为需要文本数据的组件提供相应内容。$(p)以下页面列出了使用它的那些组件。
You can place the $(thing)Text/$ widget on the $(italic)left/$ of these widgets to create a blacklist filter.
你可以将$(thing)文本/$控件放在这些控件的$(italic)左侧/$，以创建一个黑名单过滤器。
